chapters.title: The shared inbox as a crime scene

takeaways: Manual triage of shared inboxes routes work by mood instead of business logic, which leaves urgent cases buried.
Email-to-case ingestion with attachment analysis, unified routing by rules, skills and capacity, and Copilot Studio drafted replies form a three-step cleanup crew.
Roll out the scanner first, then routing, then AI drafting, and keep humans as reviewers who approve every reply.
hook: Shared support inboxes full of dead letters burn out agents and frustrate customers. This noir-style episode walks customer service leaders through three Dynamics 365 automation operators, case scanning, unified routing and Copilot Studio drafting, and shows how they turn email chaos into structured, measurable work.
